title: Smoky Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with aromatic spices, smoky notes, and tender lentils. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened (5 minutes).
Add smoked paprika, oregano, and cumin, cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils, diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer (30 minutes).
If using red wine, stir it in during the last 10 minutes of cooking.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
